ruling.reasoning:
The trip is a metered RydeTAXI ride (F7), so extra kilometres pass straight into the fare and RD-2's mileage-based refund branch applies rather than the fixed-fare branch [F7][RD-2]. The trace settles that one off-route segment exists [F3][RD-1]: 5.53 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.08 km, adding 4.45 km and peaking 1,889 m off the optimal route, inside a 13.0 km trip against a 7.7 km optimal route [F1][F3][RD-1].

Nothing in RD-3 helps the driver: no stop was measured in the segment, and no rider message named any place [F3][RD-3]. RD-4 also fails: no traffic incident at all was recorded near the route during the trip window [F14], so sub-clause (a) is closed, and the only congestion record is speed band 2 on Kampong Bahru Road running 18:16–18:34 [F11], which ends exactly when the segment begins and is at most corroborative under RD-4(b), which cannot exempt a segment on its own [F11][F3][RD-4].

On RD-5 consent: the only message before the segment is the driver's own question at 18:30, "mind if I go round via Zion Road?" [F8], and the chat record holds exactly one message, so there is no rider reply at all [F9]. A question sent early is not a consent given early — the rider's agreement message must itself predate the 18:34 segment start [F8][F9][F3][RD-5]. The driver's post-trip statement that the rider voiced "no objection" is unrecorded acquiescence asserted only in his own statement, which is not consent (G11) [F10][RD-5]. And even a reply agreeing to Zion Road would only cover driving on Zion Road: no fact ties the 18:34–18:45 segment to Zion Road, nothing places the car on a named road, and the traffic facts name other roads (Kampong Bahru, New Bridge, Sentosa Gateway) [F8][F3][F11][F12][F13][RD-5]. I therefore read the segment as an unexempted deviation rather than undetermined: the record contains no rider agreement of any scope to interpret. Accordingly the segment counts [F3][F10][RD-5][RD-3].

Amount: RD-2 refunds Σ(extra_km of unexempted segments) × the trip's per-km rate (distance fare ÷ distance km) [F4][RD-2]. Rate = $18.37 ÷ 13.03 km = $1.4098/km [F4][F7]. Refund = 4.45 km × $1.4098/km = $6.2736 → $6.27. The remaining 0.85 km of the billed 5.30 km excess (corridor back-and-forth and map-matching variance outside any segment) is expressly not refunded [F1][F3][F4][RD-2].

The $0.11 waiting item is a metered waiting unit (0.4 min at $0.26/min) and is collected on RydeTAXI wait units; it is not disputed and not refunded [F5][F7][RD-3]. No account flag attaches: RD-6 requires route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1 and the driver's profile records 0 upheld route disputes in 90 days [F17][RD-6]. Safety screened: the chat, the statement and the complaint contain no threat, intimidation, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation [F8][F9][F10][F15] — no safety escalation is warranted [SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

No rider agreement of any scope — general or named-road — predates the 18:34 segment start [F3], so the segment is not exempt and is refundable under RD-2 [RD-5][RD-2].

Not rejected as a finding but as a ground for exemption: the segment's unexempted status [F3] supports the rider, and RD-1's shortest-route duty is breached by the driver [F1][F3] [RD-1].
